description: Time-bounded audit advisory allowlist. Expired entries are treated as active (blocking) again.

allowlist.reason: ajv $data ReDoS (MODERATE) -- transitive via eslint@10.0.1 -> ajv@6.12.6. Direct ajv dependency remains 8.18.0 (patched). Remaining path is eslint's internal ajv v6.
allowlist.why_not_exploitable: ajv v6 is used internally by eslint for config schema validation. No user-supplied data reaches ajv's $data code path in our usage. Dev-only linting tool.
allowlist.where_used: Root devDependency chain: eslint@10.0.1 -> ajv@6.12.6; typescript-eslint@8.56.0 -> eslint -> ajv@6.12.6
allowlist.remediation: eslint@10.1.0+ pins ajv ^6.14.0 (patched); current pinned eslint is 10.0.1 (latest published: 10.9.0). Not bumped in this pass: eslint's own versioning policy allows a minor release to report additional lint errors, so the bump needs a full monorepo lint pass and is tracked as separate dev-tooling debt, not bundled with this allowlist renewal.
allowlist.verified_by: pnpm audit --prod shows no MODERATE for ajv; pnpm why ajv -r confirms direct ajv@8.18.0 (patched) and the sole remaining vulnerable path is eslint@10.0.1's internal ajv@6.12.6

allowlist.reason: Vite dev server arbitrary file read (HIGH): dev-only via vitest@4.1.0 -> vite@6.4.1. Not exposed in production.
allowlist.why_not_exploitable: Vite dev server is only used during local test runs via vitest. Not in published packages or production deployments.
allowlist.remediation: Update vite when vitest ships a fix or vite patches the dev server vulnerability
allowlist.verified_by: pnpm audit --prod shows no HIGH for vite; pnpm why vite confirms vitest-only path

allowlist.reason: defu prototype pollution via __proto__ key (HIGH): dev-only transitive dependency. Not in published packages.
allowlist.why_not_exploitable: defu is a transitive dev dependency used in build/test tooling. Not in published packages. No user-controlled input reaches defu in production.
allowlist.remediation: Update when upstream patches or when the consuming tool updates its dependency
allowlist.verified_by: pnpm audit --prod shows no HIGH for defu

allowlist.reason: esbuild dev server allows any website to send requests and read responses (HIGH, GHSA-gv7w-rqvm-qjhr). esbuild >=0.17.0 <0.28.1; current resolved 0.27.3 pulled transitively by the test toolchain (vitest -> vite -> tsx -> esbuild, and tsx -> esbuild).
allowlist.why_not_exploitable: The advisory affects esbuild's HTTP dev server (serve mode). PEAC never runs esbuild's serve mode; esbuild is used only as a transpiler/bundler by tsx and vite during local test and dev runs. No published @peac/* package depends on esbuild (prod audit shows no high), so there is no production code path or shipped artifact exposure.
allowlist.where_used: devDependencies only: @vitest/coverage-v8 -> vitest -> vite -> tsx -> esbuild; and tsx -> esbuild.
allowlist.remediation: Adopt the patched esbuild (>=0.28.1) when tsx/vite/vitest bump their transitive esbuild, or add a pnpm.overrides pin once toolchain compatibility with esbuild 0.28.x is confirmed.
allowlist.verified_by: pnpm audit --prod shows no high advisories; pnpm why esbuild confirms the tsx/vite/vitest dev-only resolution path.
